title: The 18:00: a note-taker, the parking in one minute, then what Monday needs
detail: The 12:00 did not happen, so its asks are here. (1) Name a note-taker in the first minute: the 18:00s of 5 and 6 November left no record. (2) Park the late, unowned issues: list ready (45 to park, 21 kept); Vicky and Dinis, yes or no in one line (125 late, 78 unowned). Recommended: yes. (3) Before Monday's collection: the garment files and Jose's navy (WS-48, Dinis and Silvio), the outreach claim so Silvio can send (WS-26, Dinis). (4) SG/Send tokens per agent for Silvio's and Jose's agents (WS-170, Dinis). (5) If time: WS-09, WS-107 (recommended: option 2, I draft, the chair confirms), WS-125. New for Dinis, no decision needed tonight: Angelo's back-office proposal (WS-180) lands in people/angelo/proposals/WS-180/. 21 decisions open. Say each as 'decided: <item>: <words>'.
